final_answer:
**Amazon's total net sales for fiscal year 2024 were $637,959 million (approximately $638.0 billion).**

Supporting source: "Net sales, fiscal year 2024: $637,959" [DOC-1], as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations of Amazon.com, Inc.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (accession 0001018724-25-000004) [DOC-1].

Comparability note: No comparability issues apply to this figure — it is a single-period, as-reported amount drawn directly from the FY2024 10-K on a consistent U.S. GAAP consolidated basis. For context, the same statement presents comparative net sales of $574,785 million for FY2023 and $513,983 million for FY2022 [DOC-1], implying year-over-year growth of approximately 11.0% in FY2024.

ANSWER: $637,959 million (approximately $638.0 billion) in net sales for fiscal year 2024
